paper_title: Searching for scalar field dark matter with LIGO
notes: LIGO O3 search for scalar field dark matter via beamsplitter/test-mass size oscillations. Sets 95% C.L. upper limits on both d_e (coupling to photons/alpha, Lambda_gamma; ScalarPhoton) and d_me (coupling to electron mass, Lambda_e; ScalarElectron) as a function of mass over a band 10 Hz - 5000 Hz (~4e-14 eV to ~2e-11 eV), with main improvement 10-180 Hz (~5e-14 to ~1e-12 eV). The analysis uses mu=Lambda_i^-2 and cannot distinguish the two couplings (assumes the other is null), so both ScalarPhoton (d_e) and ScalarElectron (d_me) are constrained in separate panels (Fig. 3a for Lambda_e, 3b for Lambda_gamma). No numerical tables or explicit limit values are provided in the text; limits are shown only in smoothed plots, so no data points are extractable. Local DM density assumed rho_CDM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3. | Vision: Plot b) shows Lambda_gamma^-1 limit corresponding to d_e (ScalarPhoton). The blue filled LIGO exclusion region's lower boundary is traced. Y-axis is Lambda^-1 in GeV^-1 with secondary d_e axis; values reported in d_e units approximately.
